title: Reset a forgotten password
body: Go to portal.company.com/reset and enter your work email address. A reset link is emailed to you and expires after 15 minutes. If the message does not arrive, check the spam folder before requesting another link.

title: Unlock a locked account
body: Accounts lock automatically after five failed sign-in attempts and unlock on their own after 30 minutes. The identity team can unlock an account sooner if the wait is blocking work.

title: VPN will not connect
body: Install GlobalConnect from the Software Center, sign in with your work credentials, and select the gateway nearest your location. If the tunnel keeps dropping, switch from Wi-Fi to a wired connection and disable any other VPN client.

title: Wi-Fi or network connectivity problems
body: Connect to the CORP-SECURE network and authenticate with your work account. If the connection fails, forget the network and rejoin, or use a wired connection. Company-wide outages are posted at status.company.com.

title: Email not sending or receiving
body: Restart Outlook and confirm the client is online. Mailboxes are capped at 50 GB, so archive older items if the mailbox is full. For phone access use the Company Portal app and sign in with your work account.

title: Install or request software
body: Approved applications are available in the Software Center and need no administrator rights. For anything not listed, raise a request at portal.company.com/software; your manager approves it before installation.

title: Printer will not print
body: Open Printers and Scanners, choose Add, and select the printer nearest your desk. Printers are named by floor, for example FL3-NE. If a printer reports offline, power-cycle it and clear any paper jam.

title: Check the status of a support ticket
body: Track any ticket at portal.company.com/tickets using its reference, which takes the form INC0012345. The status field shows the queue position and the assigned team.

title: Laptop is slow or overheating
body: Restart the machine first, since uptime beyond a week is the most common cause. Check Task Manager for a process holding high CPU, and confirm the vents are unobstructed. Persistent heat may indicate a failing fan.

title: Suspected phishing or account compromise
body: Do not click links or reply. Forward the message to phishing@company.com and delete it. If credentials may already have been entered, change your password immediately and contact the security team, because this is treated as urgent.

title: Recover a deleted or lost file
body: Check the Recycle Bin first, then use the Previous Versions tab in the file properties. Files stored in OneDrive can be restored from version history for up to 30 days. Report unrecoverable business data loss to the service desk.

title: Multi-factor authentication not working
body: Confirm the device clock is set automatically, since a drifting clock invalidates time-based codes. If the authenticator app was moved to a new phone, the identity team must re-enrol the device before sign-in will succeed.
